ED TO OB PATHWAY: TRIAGE DECISION TREE
Rebuild of the CSM ED to OB Pathway Guideline (created 10/2026) · Decision support only, not unit policy
CHRISTUS St. Michael / OBHG - Texarkana
14 October 2026
HOW TO READ THIS CHART: pick a branch, start at STEP 0, follow the arrows, and answer each yes/no question. Hexagons are questions; shaded rectangles are actions; follow any THEN arrow.
SHADING KEY: WHITE = patient stays in the Main ED LIGHT GRAY = give report, then transfer to OBED DARK GRAY = delivery imminent: L&D team to the ED
PREGNANT PATIENT AT THE MAIN ED Gestational age, then non-OB S&S, then delivery
STEP 0: START
Pregnant patient
arrives at Main ED.
Triage per protocol.
STEP 1: LESS THAN
20 WEEKS GESTATION?
YES
MAIN ED · WHITE
Stays in the Main ED for evaluation
• Consult OB as needed.
• Consider US for fetal wellbeing.
• Contact L&D if help is needed with fetal heart tones.
NO
STEP 2: ANY NON-OB S&S?
(Non-OB list in band below)
YES
MAIN ED · WHITE
Stays in the Main ED for evaluation and
treatment
Provider-to-provider consult between ED and OB for
maternal/fetal evaluation.
THEN
TO OBED · LIGHT GRAY
1. Contact the L&D charge RN
2. Once medically cleared, call L&D.
3. Transfer the patient to OBED.
NO
STEP 3: IS DELIVERY
IMMINENT?
YES
DELIVERY IMMINENT · DARK GRAY
Call L&D at 427-2606
The Neo/L&D team comes to the ED.
NO
TO OBED · LIGHT GRAY
Contact OBED RN or L&D charge RN to give report
Then transfer the patient to OBED.
POSTPARTUM: 6 WEEKS OR LESS
STEP 0P: START
Patient arrives at the Main ED and is 6 weeks or
less postpartum. Triage per protocol.
STEP 1P: ANY NON-OB S&S?
(Non-OB list in band below)
YES NO
MAIN ED
Stays in the ED for
evaluation
Consult OB as
needed.
TO OBED
Contact
OBED/L&D charge
RN for report
Then transfer the
patient to OBED.
Preeclampsia S&S apply from 20 weeks
gestation through 6 weeks postpartum (criteria in
band below). Listed with OB S&S.
L&D: 427-2606
NON-OB S&S
(YES at STEP 2 / 1P)
Any cardiac complaint(s) · SOB/respiratory infection · Trauma/non-OB injury · Suicide attempt · Communicable diseases · Sore throat/ear infections · GI symptoms ·
Stroke/Bell palsy
OB S&S
Decreased fetal movement · Vaginal bleeding · Contractions/abdominal cramping/constant pain · Leaking of fluid · Pelvic pressure · HTN/S&S of preeclampsia ·
Delivery complications
S&S OF PREECLAMPSIA
(20 weeks to 6 weeks PP)
SBP 160 or higher and/or DBP 110 or higher, OR SBP 140 to 159 and/or DBP 90 to 109 WITH unremitting headache, visual disturbances, or RUQ/epigastric pain.
ABBREVIATIONS
ED = emergency department; OBED = obstetric emergency department; L&D = labor and delivery; S&S = signs and symptoms; US = ultrasound; Neo = neonatal; PP =
postpartum; HTN = hypertension; SOB = shortness of breath; RUQ = right upper quadrant.
Decision support only, not unit policy. Source: CSM ED to OB Pathway Guideline (10/2026) + annotated paper copy; checked vs ED to OB Fast Pass (rev. 10/2026) and OB Triage ED/OBED guideline. 14 October 2026
